description: Retrieve annual greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions data for any OECD country from the OECD Environment Policy and Progress indicators database. Returns CO2-equivalent emissions (in million tonnes) broken down by gas type (CO2, CH4, N2O, F-gases, etc.) and economic sector (energy, transport, agriculture, industry, waste, etc.). Covers OECD members from 1990 to the latest available year, with data aligned to IPCC inventory guidelines and UNFCCC reporting. Useful for climate policy analysis, carbon footprint comparisons, and tracking progress towards net-zero targets. Source: OECD ENV.EPI SDMX API, CC BY 4.0, no auth required, unlimited.

country.description: ISO 3-letter OECD country code (e.g. USA, GBR, DEU, FRA, JPN, CAN, AUS, KOR, ITA, ESP). See OECD reference area codes for the full list of 38 member countries.

end_period.description: End year for GHG emissions data (e.g. "2022"). Defaults to latest available.

max_series.description: Maximum number of time series to return (1–100, default 20). Each series is a unique combination of dimensions such as sector, measure, or adjustment type.

start_period.description: Start year for GHG emissions data (e.g. "2015"). Defaults to 10 years prior.

name: oecd.environment.emissions

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: OECD Greenhouse Gas Emissions
